messages:
hana (Marketing): Pushed a near-final draft to the doc — need a quick signoff on hero headline, benchmark wording (med/p95 preferred), gated webinar + lab notebook CTA, and HubSpot wiring. Target publish Mon AM.
matt (Product): Skimming. Let's avoid vague 'faster' claims. Proposal: '45% lower median; 33% lower p95 vs baseline' with a short footnote describing test harness (synth-load v4, 8xA100, seq=1024). I can paste the appendix.
cleo (Growth): For CTAs: primary = 'Request a demo' (sales funnel), secondary = 'Register + get the lab notebook' (gated). Recommend demo:lab split 60:40 for first 72h. Also propose an email drip for notebook download.
ravi (Design): Uploaded hero comps: tight-term.png and sparkline-compact.png. Suggest headline variants in the doc: A) 'Predictable tail latency for production' B) 'Lower p95, same quality'. My vote is A for broader audience.
hana (Marketing): Good options. We should A/B headline on preview. Who can sign hero copy? @ravi for visuals, @cleo for CTA placement.
cleo (Growth): I can sign off on CTA layout after we confirm HubSpot flows and confirmation email copy.
oscar (Growth Ops): HubSpot plan: two lists -> "launch_demo_requests" and "launch_lab_notebook"; utm_campaign=redwood-northstar-q2. Form embed snippet I'll put in the doc: `<!-- HS form -->\n<form data-portal="12345" data-form="abc987">...</form>`. Scoring: +50 demo, +35 notebook, threshold 70 to SDR.
matt (Product): Fine. Add a short paragraph comparing latency vs a widely used open baseline (no vendor names) to help enterprise readers. I'll add numbers and the test note to appendix.
hana (Marketing): Webinar tie-in: schedule Thurs 11:00 PT (30 min demo + Q&A). We'll gate the lab notebook behind registration. Cleo, can you draft webinar landing blurbs?
cleo (Growth): Yup — will write two variants: technical (engineer-focused) and executive (impact-focused). Also propose adding a small gated 1-page checklist for SREs.
ravi (Design): Small copy ask: hero subline should reference 'real-world p95' not just 'latency'. Made that tweak in the mock.
oscar (Growth Ops): I'll also set Mixpanel events: 'article_view', 'notebook_registered', 'demo_requested'. Will paste tracking params in the doc and wire the HS lists.
staging-bot: preview scheduled: staging build queued for 2026-04-20T08:00:00Z for thread 6112233445
hana (Marketing): Timeline recap: copy freeze 18:00 PT today, design lock 18:30 PT, HS wiring by 20:00 PT, staging preview 08:00 PT Monday. If any blockers, flag now.
matt (Product): Appendix uploaded with exact med/p95 deltas and test harness details.
cleo (Growth): I'll prepare CTA variants and email confirmations and drop notes when done.
oscar (Growth Ops): HubSpot form code and list creation complete in the doc. I'll run a quick test submission and report back.
hana (Marketing): Thanks team  I'll run a final editorial sweep after the test submission and queue the preview if all green. :rocket:
